title: POC field diary and constraint tally
content:
Purpose
------
This is a working field diary for the Aurelia Financial POC (search & triage assistant) capturing week-by-week activities, emergent constraints, workshop takeaways, and an explicit fallthrough plan for when latency/cost/throughput gates are hit. Use as the single source during the trial acceleration phase.

Context snapshot
----------------
- Customer: Aurelia Financial (risk/ops teams)
- Scope: Ingest 18 months of anonymized support tickets + knowledge base, provide a triage assistant (suggest categories, surface precedents, return ranked retrievals).
- Primary success metric: 90% precision on triage labels in pilot set + median inference latency < 120ms for top-1 token generation path under steady load.
- Duration: 6-week technical pilot (engineering handoff to Aurelia at week 7).

High-level objectives for this doc
--------------------------------
1) Track day-to-day decisions that affect rollout cadence and model choices.
2) Maintain a running tally of constraints (e.g., KMS requirements, network egress patterns, token cost caps).
3) Capture workshop notes (customer asks, demo feedback, unresolved risk items).
4) Document fallthrough strategies (model variants, routing policies, degraded UX modes).

Week-by-week sprint diary (concise)
----------------------------------
Week 0 (kickoff) - 2024-11-20
- Kickoff workshop with Aurelia ops + legal. Key asks: FIPS-compatible KMS, audit logs, and ability to pin a model to Dedicated if needed.
- Action: SE infra to surface KMS integration checklist (assigned: Priya, due 2024-11-25).
- Note: Customer expects PII redaction in pipeline; they will provide sample PII tags.

Week 1 - 2024-11-27 to 2024-12-03
- Data ingest prep: schemas accepted with minor mapping mismatches.
- Decided: use hosted API for rapid iteration; plan Dedicated trial in week 4 if throughput tests fail.
- Daily ops: small, noisy spike in long-context threads -> plan to enable prefix caching for conversation histories.
- Task opened: JIRA-2189 (ingest mapping fix) -> Miguel.

Week 2 - 2024-12-04 to 2024-12-10
- Evaluation harness established: 5k labeled tickets held-out. Baseline model: open-llm-v2-small (quantized).
- Result: baseline triage precision 78% (target 90%). Latency median 95ms at 10 rps. Cost per query within budget for hosted mode.
- Decision: increase context window to 6k tokens for precedent retrieval; will measure latency after caching enabled.

Week 3 - 2024-12-11 to 2024-12-17
- Workshop with Aurelia product: acceptance criteria refined (top-3 recall 95% on precedents).
- Discovered: customer legal needs regionally-resident logs for EU customers -> privacy constraint added.
- Risk: dedicated infra lead out on PTO week 4 -> contingency: use Redwood Console tracing to capture perf data instead of manual SSH on Dedicated.

Week 4 - 2024-12-18 to 2024-12-24
- Throughput test: switched to continuous batching and KV cache; throughput improved 2.3x.
- Observed tail-latency regressions at 50 rps in hosted (long context paths).
- Mitigation: configure smart routing to spill to lower-latency region and fall back to smaller quantized model for non-critical requests.

Week 5 - 2024-12-25 to 2025-01-01
- Customer workshop: live demo with 3 stakeholders; feedback: confidence scoring and audit trail UI are high priority.
- Action: Product to prototype logs->UI mapping (Priya + Aurelia UX lead).
- Regression: small quality drop when using 4-bit quantization on the retrieval-augmented prompt path.

Emergent constraints (running tally)
-----------------------------------
- Security/Compliance:
  - KMS: must be FIPS-compatible for EU production.
  - Audit: retention window 12 months for logs, redaction markers required.

- Performance:
  - Latency budget: median 120ms, p95 < 400ms for triage endpoints.
  - Throughput: baseline expected 20 rps during business hours, bursts to 70 rps tolerated for 10 minutes.

- Cost:
  - Trial budget cap: $7k total cloud inference spend for the pilot.
  - Per-customer token cap: 500k tokens per month for pilot.

- Data handling:
  - EU datasets must remain on EU region.
  - PII redaction: pipeline must flag and scrub before storing indices.

Operational playbook snippets (actions + owners)
------------------------------------------------
- Ingest validation failure -> immediate rollback to last good mapping, notify Aurelia slack channel, tag SE oncall. (owner: Miguel)
- Latency spike detected (p95 > 400ms) -> switch route policy to fallback model variant with 50% canary for 2 minutes, escalate to infra. (owner: Liam)
- Cost burn > 60% of trial budget before week 4 -> throttle sampling rate, reduce summary length. (owner: Ava)

Simple timeline (key milestones)
-------------------------------
- Week 0: Kickoff + data access checks (done)
- Week 2: Baseline eval + latency/cost baseline (done)
- Week 4: Throughput stress + Dedicated gating decision (in progress)
- Week 6: Final acceptance test + handoff (planned 2025-01-22)

Fallthrough strategies (explicit)
--------------------------------
1) Model variant fallback ladder (fast -> slow):
   - small-quantized (q4) hosted -> small-quantized (q4) regionally routed -> medium-quantized with prefix cache -> fallback to rule-based classifier for triage label only.
2) UX degradation modes:
   - full feature -> no precedents (fast label only) -> batched daily digest only.
3) Routing policies:
   - primary: lowest-latency region matching data residency
   - secondary: lowest-cost region with compatible model (if latency SLO still met)

Workshop notes (raw highlights)
------------------------------
- "We need to see audit evidence that a label came from model X at time Y" (Aurelia lead). Action: include model_id + version in audit rows.
- Prefer rolling 2-week canary for any Dedicated cutover.
- UX ask: allow reviewers to correct triage and have corrections flow back into short-term cache for re-ranking.

Open questions (prioritized)
---------------------------
- Q1: Is Dedicated required for pilot acceptance or just for Production? (Aurelia legal vs product mismatch). Current leaning: allow Hosted for pilot, Dedicated for production. (owner: Ava)
- Q2: PII redaction: will Aurelia provide their redaction model or do we auto-detect with Redwood pipeline? (owner: Priya)
- Q3: Can audit retention be provided via Redwood Console export to customer S3 with encryption? (owner: Miguel)

Decisions log (short)
---------------------
- 2024-11-22: Use hosted API for initial 3 weeks (decision reason: speed of iteration). (decider: Ava, Miguel)
- 2024-12-20: Enable prefix KV caching across sessions for long-context workloads. (decider: Miguel)
- 2024-12-29: If p95 tail-latency persists at production-scale test -> propose Dedicated trial. (decider: Ava)

Next immediate actions (next 7 days)
-----------------------------------
- Priya: deliver KMS integration checklist and compliance note (due 2024-11-25) [blocked by legal follow-up].
- Miguel: close JIRA-2189 (ingest mapping), validate logs export prototype (due 2024-11-28).
- Liam: run focused p95 stress at 35 rps (simulated business load) and attach flame graphs to the ticket (due 2024-11-30).
- Ava: schedule product workshop to capture UI audit needs (calendar invite sent).

Quick contact map
-----------------
- Customer eng lead: Sofia Reyes (sofia.reyes@aureliafin.com)
- SE lead: Ava Chen (ava@redwood.com)
- Infra POC: Liam O'Neill (liam@redwood.com)
- Compliance: Priya Kapoor (priya@redwood.com)

Appendix: compact risk matrix (handy)
------------------------------------
- Risk: PII leak during indexing. Severity: High. Mitigation: require sample verification step; redact before index. Owner: Priya.
- Risk: Dedicated ramp takes longer than 2 weeks. Severity: Medium. Mitigation: maintain hosted fallback and transparent dashed SLA in slides. Owner: Ava.
- Risk: Trial burn > budget. Severity: Medium. Mitigation: token caps + sampling + summary length cap. Owner: Miguel.

Notes to self (informal)
-----------------------
- Keep this diary as the canonical timeline for postmortems.
- Save demo recordings to linked Confluence page and timestamp key moments.
- When in doubt, surface regression examples to Aurelia early (they prefer to triage quickly).

EOF
